# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 簪也。从竹幵聲。
As per 巴# (spread) + 竹 bamboo → (spreading,) thorny *bamboo*; (thorny) *bamboo fence*.
As per 及# (press on) + 竹 bamboo → (bamboo) *container* for clothes, books and other objects, carried on the back.
As per 爪# (pick/pluck) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo ladle for plucking objects out of a container → (bamboo) *colander*. Also, *nest* (← resemblance in shape to a colander; compare 巣).
羊車騶箠也。箸箴其耑，長半分。从竹内聲。

As per 勿# (obscure) + 竹 bamboo → *thin tablet*, obscure on account of its thinness. Such tablets were once made of bamboo, but later often made of ivory or other precious materials. The tablet originally signified authority, but later came to indicate a slat used by attendees of imperial audiences to take notes. The reading シャク is a borrowed meaning, as are the meanings *mace* and *scepter*.
公及士所搢也。从竹勿聲。案：籒文作𡇉，象形。義云佩也。古笏佩之。此字後人所加。
竹列也。从竹亢聲。

As per 夭# (slender and limber) + 竹 bamboo → slender, flexible bamboo. 笑 came to assume the meanings of a separate character that added 口 mouth and meant the same thing as the predecessor of 咲 (open the mouth slightly in smiling/laughing) → *smile*; *laugh*.
此字本闕。
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 竹 bamboo → (bamboo) *whip* fixed upon the flesh of one being punished.
折竹箠也。从竹占聲。潁川人名小兒所書寫爲笘。
As per 生# (fresh) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo instrument producing a fresh sound → *flute*; *reed instrument*.
十三簧。象鳳之身也。笙，正月之音。物生，故謂之笙。大者謂之巢，小者謂之和。从竹生聲。古者隨作笙。
As per 由# (pass/run through) + 竹 (rigid, tubular) bamboo → *flute/pipe* (← cylindrical instruments through which sound passes) → *whistle*.
七孔筩也。从竹由聲。羌笛三孔。
As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 竹 bamboo → (bamboo) *rod* or *whip*, brought down with great force.
擊也。从竹台聲。
As per 立# (exert continuous downward pressure) + 竹 bamboo → *bamboo hat* weighing heavily on the head.
簦無柄也。从竹立聲。
竹膚也。从竹民聲。
As per 司# (peer through a hole) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo *box* with small holes allowing a view of the contents → *wicker basket*; *chest* (to store clothes); *container* (for cooked rice).
飯及衣之器也。从竹司聲。
As per 付# (set in place) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo tablet/tally split in two to make a pledge, the pieces of which, when set in place, *fit together exactly* → *tally*; *marker* → *paper charm*; *code*.
信也。漢制以竹，長六寸，分而相合。从竹付聲。
As per 冊# (bamboo slats) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo *weir* (← contraption of bamboo slats; compare 柵).
本# base + 竹 bamboo → the *rough*/*coarse* base of a bamboo tree.
竹裏也。从竹本聲。
笞也。从竹旦聲。
牀簀也。从竹𠂔聲。
An abbreviated form# of 弟 (vertical alignment) + 竹 bamboo → neatly stacked pieces of bamboo (compare the bamboo counting sticks in 算) → *ordinal number*; *prefix*; *grade*; *degree* (← stacking).
車笭也。从竹令聲。一曰笭，籯也。
迫也。在瓦之下，棼上。从竹乍聲。
鳥籠也。从竹奴聲。
As per 句# (bend) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo bent to create a *fish trap*.
曲竹捕魚笱也。从竹从句，句亦聲。
As per 加# (place atop) + 竹 bamboo → *reed flute* (created by overlapping layers of material; compare 葭).
As per 可# (bend) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo bent to form an *arrow shaft* (compare 簳).
氾# overflow + 竹 bamboo → *bamboo frame* designed to contain liquid and prevent it from overflowing → *rule*; *law* (← elements that contain/delimit human actions; compare 法, 憲, 律 and 埒).
法也。从竹，竹，𥳑書也；氾聲。古法有竹刑。
竹 bamboo + 世 successive → *bamboo grass* (that grows in rapid succession).
桮笿也。从竹各聲。
As per 先# (small increments) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo *whisk* (used to whip powdered tea in small increments).
聿# implement used to carve/draw characters + 竹 bamboo → bamboo carved into a *writing brush* → *writing implements*; *write*; *draw*; (literary/artistic) *work*.
秦謂之筆。从聿从竹。

As per 舌# (chisel-like implement in motion) + 竹 bamboo → notch an arrow with a chisel-like implement → *notch of an arrow*; *notch on a bow* (for a bowstring). Also, *should/must* (be) and *have the expectation that* (← fitting idea ← bowstring fitting the notch of an arrow).
As per 寺# (stand straight) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo stalks/pieces of *equal* height, arranged vertically → *equivalent*; *grade*; *rank*; *et cetera* (← listing of equivalent/similar items).
齊簡也。从竹从寺。寺，官曹之等平也。
竹索也。从竹交聲。

Originally 竹 bamboo + a depiction of connected joints (now written 肋) → the hard portion of bamboo between the joints, used in bow-making. *Muscle*, *line*, *lineage*, and *thread/plot* (of a story or line of reasoning) derive from the distinct lines of the bamboo, with *reason*, *logic* and (information) *source* by extension. Regarding the progression from "line" to "reason/logic," compare 理.
肉之力也。从力从肉从竹。竹，物之多筋者。凡筋之屬皆从筋。
As per 全# (fully) + 竹 bamboo → *fish trap* filled with the fish caught in it. Compare 栫.
As per 旬# (cycle/circle) + 竹 bamboo → circular clump of *bamboo shoot*s.
竹胎也。从竹旬聲。
As per 伐# (cut down) + 竹 bamboo → cut down bamboo and fashion it into a *raft*.
As per 匡# (extend within a framing object) + 竹 bamboo → objects extending within a *bamboo basket*.
巩 as described in 恐 (connect objects) + 竹# bamboo → ancient, stringed *musical instrument* played by being struck forcefully with a bamboo stick.
以竹曲五弦之樂也。从竹从𢀜。𢀜，持之也。竹亦聲。
As per 同# (run through) + 竹 (rigid, tubular) bamboo → (bamboo) *tube* through which liquids or solids run → *pipe*; *gun barrel*.
通簫也。从竹同聲。

As per 合# (press/fit together) + 竹 bamboo → fit/fasten a cover upon a bamboo vessel → *answer*; *solve* (← answer/solution that corresponds to a question ← lid that corresponds to a container) → *repay*; *reward* (← make a fitting return).
朿# thorn + 竹 bamboo → sharp-pronged whip/stick for taming a horse. *Policy*, *plan*, (bamboo) *slat*, *record* and *document* are all borrowed meanings (for bamboo writing slats, compare 冊).
馬箠也。从竹朿聲。
筳也。从竹孚聲。讀若《春秋》魯公子彄。
均# even/equal + 竹 bamboo → smooth, even-sufaced *bamboo skin* → *bamboo*.
竹皮也。从竹均聲。
折竹笢也。从竹余聲。讀若絮。
籃也。从竹良聲。
An abbreviated form# of 宮 (winding) + 竹 bamboo → *round basket* (made of bamboo or other material that has been wound about); *stackable boxes*. Also, by shape association, a *bundle of rice plants*.
䈰也。从竹呂聲。

As per 完# (surround completely) + 竹 bamboo → hands surrounding a bamboo pipe or *flute* → *rounded key* (← shape association). The meaning *be in charge* appears to be connected with the use of a flute; compare 管.
筟也。从竹完聲。
As per 見# (fix upon) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo/wooden *water pipe* affixed in place → *conduit*.
As per 甬# (run through) + 竹 (rigid, tubular) bamboo → *bamboo tube* (through which a fishing line would be run).
斷竹也。从竹甬聲。
As per 成# (straight) + 竹 bamboo → straight, bamboo *reed* (of a loom).
長六寸。計歷數者。从竹从弄。言常弄乃不誤也。

筮 is 巫 sorcery + 竹 bamboo. However, the character originally included another element#, 廾 pair of hands, written at the bottom. Here, 廾 acted as an abbreviated form of the now-disappeared element described in 泰 that combined 廾 with 水 water, indicating an outpouring of liquid → bamboo *divining rod* used to locate water → *divination*.
《易》卦用蓍也。从竹从𢍮。𢍮，古文巫字。
As per 助# (supplementary power) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo tongs or *chopsticks* (← implements supplementing the fingers in eating or taking portions of food). Compare 箸.
作# make/craft + 竹 bamboo → craft a rope from bamboo strips → *bamboo rope*.
筊也。从竹作聲。
箭屬。小竹也。从竹攸聲。
As per 肖# (resemble in miniature) + 竹 bamboo → small *basket/container* of woven bamboo in which boiled rice is kept.
繀絲筦也。从竹廷聲。

As per 夾# (pressed between) + 竹 bamboo → variety of *bean plant* (compare 荅), the stalk of which was used in divination (compare 筮 and 蓍). Also, *bamboo writing brush* and *chopsticks* → *insert* and *sandwich between*, as well as *inscribed tablets*.
延# extend + 竹 bamboo → weave using extensive strips of bamboo → *bamboo-woven mat* → (straw) *mat* → *seat*.
竹席也。从竹延聲。《周禮》曰：“度堂以筵。”筵一丈。

entries.text: 竹箬也。从竹咅聲。
簁箄也。从竹卑聲。
蔽也，所以蔽甑底。从竹𢌿聲。
As per 固# (hardened/hard object) + 竹 bamboo → hard pieces of bamboo → *counter* (← bamboo pieces used as counters) → *this*; *that* (← count this piece, count that piece).
竹枚也。从竹固聲。
As per 戔# (fine/slight) + 竹 bamboo → fine, inscribed pieces of bamboo → *paper*; *stationery* (← bamboo as a writing medium) → *letter*; *composition*.
表識書也。从竹戔聲。
鼓弦竹身樂也。从竹爭聲。
扇也。从竹疌聲。
As per 帚# (sweep with a broom) + 竹 bamboo → (bamboo) *broom*.
As per 泊# (spread over) + 竹 bamboo → thin layer of *gilt* spread over bamboo → *gilding* → (gilded) *bamboo screen* (compare 蔀).
As per 其# (winnow) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo *winnow* → *winnowing fan/fork*. 箕 was devised to replace 其 after the latter's transformation of meaning.
簸也。从竹；𠀠，象形；下其丌也。凡箕之屬皆从箕。

祘 is a depiction of calculating sticks used by being placed in close, circular formation. The relevant seal inscription form of 筭 is an abbreviated form# of 祘 + an element combining 竹 bamboo and 廾 pair of hands → arrange bamboo calculating sticks in making calculations → *calculate*; *count* → *estimate*; *number*; *enumerate*; *rank*. The present form substitutes an abbreviated form of 具 (tool) in place of the calculating sticks element.
數也。从竹从具。讀若筭。
As per 囷# (round) + 竹 bamboo → tubular *bamboo* (shoots). *Bamboo grove* is via reinterpretation (← round growth of bamboo in a grove).
箘簬也。从竹囷聲。一曰博棊也。
As per 服# (spread over) + 竹 bamboo → *quiver* spread over a person's back (compare 備).
弩矢箙也。从竹服聲。《周禮》：“仲秋獻矢箙。”
As per 答# (fit/fasten a cover upon) + 刀 sword/knife → *pin down/in place*; *fasten* → *official document/communique* (fastened in place).
吹鞭也。从竹孤聲。
拑# clamp + 竹 bamboo → bamboo object facilitating clamping → *clamp down*; *sandwich* (v.) → *shut one's mouth*; *remain silent*.
籋也。从竹拑聲。
垂 here an abbreviated form# of 捶 whip + 竹 (rigid, tubular) bamboo → (bamboo) *horse whip* → *whip* used to punish criminals; *to whip/flog*.
擊馬也。从竹𡍮聲。

As per 官# (wrap about/enclose) + 竹 bamboo → (bamboo) *pipe*; *tube*; *flute*. There is no longer any specific connection with bamboo. * Control* is a borrowed meaning via the acquired, associated meaning of 官, here possibly with respect to the control exercised in playing a wind instrument; compare 筦.
如篪，六孔。十二月之音。物開地牙，故謂之管。从竹官聲。
楚謂竹皮曰箬。从竹若聲。
As per 前# (cut/shear in small increments) + 竹 bamboo → fashion a (bamboo) *arrow*.
矢也。从竹前聲。
竹輿也。从竹便聲。
相# mutual + 竹 bamboo → bamboo baskets hung from both sides of a vehicle → *box*; *container*.
大車牝服也。从竹相聲。

As per 咸# (shut) + 竹 bamboo → *(bamboo) needle* (used to shut off open wounds). Compare 鍼. Also, *admonition*, *warning* and *counsel* (← words that penetrate like a needle to another person's heart).
綴衣箴也。从竹咸聲。
As per 者# (pile) + 竹 bamboo → use bamboo *chopsticks* to remove portions from a pile of food. *Wear* is a borrowed meaning.
飯攲也。从竹者聲。
小籟也。从竹約聲。
以竿擊人也。从竹削聲。虞舜樂曰箾韶。

As per 即# (immediately beside) + 竹 bamboo → knots of a bamboo tree in proximate alignment → *knot*; *joint*; *knob*; *section*. Also, *season* (← 1/24th of a year), *tune/melody* (← song punctuated by many stops) and *frugal* (← join segments in economizing).
竹約也。从竹即聲。
As per 皇# (extend) + 竹 bamboo → extensive *bamboo grove*. Also, a large variety of *bamboo*.
竹田也。从竹皇聲。
An abbreviated form# of 笵 bamboo frame + 車 vehicle → frame/mold for creating vehicle parts → *model*; *exemplar*; *limit* (← framing).
範軷也。从車，笵省聲。讀與犯同。
以判竹圜以盛穀也。从竹耑聲。
As per 彖# (drooping/pendent) + 竹 bamboo (→ bamboo writing brush → writing) → *drooping style for writing Han/Chinese characters* → *seal script*; *seal*.
引書也。从竹彖聲。
As per 扁# (spread, but remain in contact) + 竹 bamboo → bound set of inscribed, bamboo strips → *book*; *chapter*; *section*; *article*; *counter* for poems or articles.
書也。一曰關西謂榜曰篇。从竹扁聲。
As per 筑# (strike forcefully) + 木 tree/wood → forcefully strike pieces of wood in constructing → *build/construct*.
擣也。从木筑聲。
As per 匧# as described in 愜 (contents tightly pressed into a container) + 竹 bamboo → (rectangular, bamboo) *box*, chest or case. Compare 匣.
吹筩也。从竹秋聲。
小管謂之篎。从竹眇聲。
高# high/tall + 竹 bamboo → *long bamboo pole* raised high in propelling small rivercraft.
所以進船也。从竹高聲。
As per 匪# (basket) + 竹 bamboo → *bamboo basket (with a lid opening to both sides)*. 篚 was devised to replace 匪 after the latter's transformation of meanings.
車笭也。从竹匪聲。
As per 冓# (symmetry) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo frame → *bamboo basket*. (Camp/beacon) *fire* (compare 熊) is a borrowed meaning.
笿也。可熏衣。从竹冓聲。宋楚謂竹篝牆以居也。
As per 條# (slender and curved) + 竹 bamboo → *small and slender variety of bamboo* → *bamboo grass*.
屰而奪取曰篡。从厶算聲。
竹# (rigid) bamboo + 馬 horse → startled horse (compare 驚) standing rigid in attention → *be attentive* (← thoroughness) → *cordial*; *kind*.
馬行頓遟。从馬竹聲。
As per 栗# (sting) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo instrument that stings the lips in being played. Compare 喇. The compound 篳篥 refers to an oboe-like instrument.
Variant form of 毘# connect + 竹 bamboo → bamboo comb (with fine teeth connected to the shaft). *Arrow shaft* and *spatula* are borrowed meanings. Note a variant form, 箆.
導也。今俗謂之篦。从竹𣬉聲。
As per 除# (level off) + 竹 bamboo → bamboo mats/matting that level off an uneven seating surface → *mat*; *matting*.
籧篨也。从竹除聲。
As per 師# (lead) + 竹 bamboo → lead/conduct water via a (bamboo) *filter*/*sifter* ( compare 簁 and 沙) → *sieve*; *sift*.
As per 虒# as described in 遞 (sequential) + 竹 bamboo → (eight-holed) *bamboo flute* (played by moving the fingers sequentially over the holes).
㒼爰也。从竹部聲。
As per 畢# (split away) + 竹 bamboo → split bamboo and create *wicker* (compare 蓽) → *bamboo fence*; *bamboo screen*.
藩落也。从竹畢聲。《春秋傳》曰：“篳門圭窬。”
逢# meet + 竹 bamboo → weave rushes, causing the material to meet (compare 縫) → rush-woven *awning* (for vehicles or boats) → *small boat*.
As per 參# (slender hairpins) + 竹 bamboo → *bamboo hairpin*. Compare 簪.
差也。从竹𠻝聲。
飲馬器也。从竹兜聲。
禁苑也。从竹御聲。《春秋傳》曰：“澤之目篽。”
圜竹器也。从竹專聲。
